dog.description_text:
Meet Carmine! 10 lbs of pure sweetness wrapped up in 1 lovable fur ball. He is an apricot mini poodle. This southern gentleman is a owner surrender from Georgia. He is a curious gentle boy that loves to stay close to his humans, making new dog friends, and exploring the world around him. He is timid and needs someone with patience that will allow him to come out of his shell and receive the love and pampering he deserves. While he can be nervous when left alone, he is otherwise a quiet, calm and affectionate companion with so much love to give. His favorite things include exploring the yard, being close to his people and hugs.
My foster dog is good with dogs. He is working on potty training and is getting better every day! Get ready to fall in love!

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it’s a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs. Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
dog.name: Clerk Carmine (Carmine)
